segments.sn13.5:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati … pe …“seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, puriso mahāpathaviyā satta kolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā upanikkhipeyya.
segments.sn13.5:1.3: Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ, yā vā satta kolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā upanikkhittā ayaṃ [yā (syā. ka.)] vā mahāpathavī”ti?
segments.sn13.5:2.3: Neva satimaṃ kalaṃ upenti na sahassimaṃ kalaṃ upenti na satasahassimaṃ kalaṃ upenti mahāpathaviṃ upanidhāya satta kolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā upanikkhittā”ti.

lines: Pariyosāne pana aññatitthiyasamaṇabrāhmaṇaparibbājakānaṃ adhigamoti bāhirakānaṃ sabbopi guṇādhigamo paṭhamamaggena adhigataguṇānaṃ satabhāgampi sahassabhāgampi satasahassabhāgampi na upagacchatīti.
